olympiads_grades_valid.name: olympiads_grades_valid
olympiads_grades_valid.value: ("olympiads"."grade_from" is null and "olympiads"."grade_to" is null) or ("olympiads"."grade_from" is not null and "olympiads"."grade_to" is not null and "olympiads"."grade_from" between 1 and 11 and "olympiads"."grade_to" between "olympiads"."grade_from" and 11)

series_benefits_scores_valid.name: series_benefits_scores_valid
series_benefits_scores_valid.value: ("series_benefits"."min_score" is null or "series_benefits"."min_score" between 0 and 100) and ("series_benefits"."max_score" is null or ("series_benefits"."max_score" between 0 and 100 and "series_benefits"."min_score" is not null and "series_benefits"."max_score" >= "series_benefits"."min_score"))

series_stages_dates_ordered.name: series_stages_dates_ordered
series_stages_dates_ordered.value: "series_stages"."begins_on" is null or "series_stages"."ends_on" is null or "series_stages"."begins_on" <= "series_stages"."ends_on"

stages_dates_ordered.name: stages_dates_ordered
stages_dates_ordered.value: "olympiad_stages"."begins_on" is null or "olympiad_stages"."ends_on" is null or "olympiad_stages"."begins_on" <= "olympiad_stages"."ends_on"

stages_verified_evidence.name: stages_verified_evidence
stages_verified_evidence.value: "olympiad_stages"."verification" <> 'verified' or ("olympiad_stages"."origin" = 'verified_import' and "olympiad_stages"."source_url" is not null and "olympiad_stages"."verified_at" is not null and ("olympiad_stages"."begins_on" is not null or "olympiad_stages"."ends_on" is not null))

stages_csv_no_dates.name: stages_csv_no_dates
stages_csv_no_dates.value: "olympiad_stages"."origin" <> 'csv' or ("olympiad_stages"."begins_on" is null and "olympiad_stages"."ends_on" is null and "olympiad_stages"."verification" = 'unverified')

university_programs_score_valid.name: university_programs_score_valid
university_programs_score_valid.value: "university_programs"."passing_score" is null or ("university_programs"."passing_score" between 0 and 500 and "university_programs"."passing_year" is not null)
